questions.question: Which instrument and unit would you use to measure the fun run route? Explain why.
questions.expected_answer: A trundle wheel, because the route is long and goes around corners and along streets. Record the length in metres or kilometres, because it is far too long for centimetres.

questions.question: Which is longer, 1,2 m or 115 cm? Explain how you know.
questions.expected_answer: Change them into the same unit. 1,2 m is 120 cm, and 120 cm is more than 115 cm, so 1,2 m is longer.

questions.question: Explain why 4 cm and 5 mm is written as 4,5 cm and not 4,05 cm.
questions.expected_answer: There are 10 mm in 1 cm, so 5 mm is 5 tenths of a centimetre. That makes 4,5 cm, which is also 45 mm.
